claim_boundary: Executable E2/E3 CPU Gate using real public unmodified draft and target checkpoints. Draft prefill/decode, tokenizer bridge, every target verification position, argmax/comparison, mismatch repair, real same-tokenizer cache crop/replay or cross-tokenizer rebuild, N/A, wall time, cache bytes, resident parameter bytes, RSS, and exact terminal-state comparison are recorded. Target prompt prefill is excluded symmetrically as the warm-prefix boundary. No compression credit is used for promotion. A pass authorizes only a larger-ratio and target-hardware rung; it is not 405B/8-GiB/4B-latency evidence.
